messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Using GraphViz to Visual Shiny reactive dependencies. Fun
parts:
Cool :)

Are you aware of the visualizer that's now built into Shiny? From ?showReactLog:

To use the reactive log visualizer, start with a fresh R session and run the command options(shiny.reactlog=TRUE); then launch your application in the usual way (e.g. using runApp). At any time you can hit Ctrl+F3 (or for Mac users, Command+F3) in your web browser to launch the reactive log visualization.

It's quite a different approach though and may not be useful for the same purposes as yours.

messages.subject: Re: Using GraphViz to Visual Shiny reactive dependencies. Fun
parts:
You need to download graphviz http://www.graphviz.org/Download..php

At the end of my code you should see a .txt file being written out. Just copy that code into the graphviz front end. On Windows the front end is called GVedit. Open it and paste the code into the terminal

Press the Running man icon then you get your graph
